name: agent-plan
description: Version-controlled plan storage for agent-driven coding workflows, without cluttering your main repo.

scripts.build:all: bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/apl-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/apl-darwin-x64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/apl-linux-x64
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
